newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian president's visit to Saudi Arabia during annual pilgrimage is ruled out.
- Four German tourists who were taken hostage on March 28 were released in Yemen.
- Yemen signs an oil exploration deal with Hungary's MOL.
- Israel worried about possible U.S. pressure to stop building of new settlments.
- Lebanon forms a ministerial committee to ease tension between the president and his prime minister.
- Qatar's bourse to open in mid-May. Trading is limited to Qataris.
- Construction work on an $85 million oil storing facility starts in Fujairah emirate in the United Arab Emirates.
